## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] I ran the app and tried the change myself
- [ ] New behaviour has a test (or I explained below why not)
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or stray `console.log` in the diff
- [ ] Inputs are validated on the server; permissions are checked on the server
- [ ] README / `docs/api-contract.md` updated if commands or endpoints changed
- [ ] If AI helped: I can explain every line, and `AI_LOG.md` has an entry
